scope: All 164 mapped Clos de Vougeot parcels and all 69 recorded right-holder identifiers inventoried at Tier 1. Rights history 2019–2025, cadastral lineage, seven regional notice occurrences (17 page images) and the departmental index screened. Four notices explicitly name seven current parcels. No independent domaine crosswalk or company filing is inferred from legal names; Tier 2 remains deferred. No current farmer is verified.
